system_family: mixed: 106 single-member districts and 93 national list seats
allocation_method: national list seats: highest averages over list votes plus surplus votes (§ 16)

national_rules.nationalAllocation: List votes plus surplus votes (töredékszavazat) of qualifying party lists, shared out by highest averages (§ 16).
national_rules.districtAllocation: One round in each of 106 single-member districts; the candidate with the most valid votes is elected (§ 13). District seats per list come from the National Election Office's chamber-composition record; district votes and per-district results are not held.

thresholds.appliesTo: party list

description.en: A party list below 5% of all valid party-list and nationality-list votes wins no list seat (§ 14(1)).
description.zh-CN: 政党名单得票低于政党名单和民族名单有效票总数的 5% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 1 款）。

thresholds.appliesTo: joint party list of two parties

description.en: A joint list of two parties below 10% of the same total wins no list seat (§ 14(2)).
description.zh-CN: 两党联合名单低于同一总数的 10% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 2 款）。

thresholds.appliesTo: joint party list of more than two parties

description.en: A joint list of more than two parties below 15% of the same total wins no list seat (§ 14(2)).
description.zh-CN: 两党以上联合名单低于同一总数的 15% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 2 款）。

minorityRepresentation.en: A nationality list wins one preferential seat if its votes reach the quota: all national list votes ÷ 93 ÷ 4, whole part (§ 16(d) and (e)). Nationality lists are a separate ballot with their own denominator here.
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 民族名单得票达到配额（全部全国名单票 ÷ 93 ÷ 4，取整数部分）时获得一个优惠席位（第 16 条 d、e 项）。此处民族名单是单独的选票，使用各自的分母。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 199 seats by statute: 106 single-member districts and 93 national list seats (§ 3). Each list shows its national list seats (National Election Commission minutes), its district seats (National Election Office chamber-composition record) and their sum, the whole-chamber seats.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 法定 199 席：106 个单一选区席位和 93 个全国名单席位（第 3 条）。各名单显示全国名单席位（国家选举委员会会议记录）、选区席位（国家选举办公室议会构成记录）及两者之和，即全议院席位。

notes.en: Mixed system with 199 seats: 93 national list seats and 106 single-member district seats. Every seat is attributed here: list seats come from the minutes, district seats from the election office's composition page, and the two add up to 199. "National list seats" are the list tier only; "whole-chamber seats" add the district seats. Shares are computed here within each ballot. The election office's application prints shares over party-list and nationality-list votes together, so its figures differ. No nationality list reached the preferential quota, so all 93 list seats went to party lists. A joint list's votes and seats, including the district seats of candidates nominated by the same organisations, are not divided among its organisations.
notes.zh-CN: 混合选制，共 199 席：93 个全国名单席位和 106 个单一选区席位。此处每个席位都已归属：名单席位来自会议记录，选区席位来自选举办公室的议会构成页面，两者合计 199 席。"全国名单席位"仅指名单层级；"全议院席位"另加选区席位。得票率在各选票内部计算。选举办公室的应用程序按政党名单票和民族名单票合计计算得票率，因此数字不同。没有民族名单达到优惠配额，因此 93 个名单席位全部分配给政党名单。联合名单的票数和席位（包括由相同组织共同提名的候选人赢得的选区席位）不分配给其各组织。

notes.zh-CN: 混合选制，共 199 席：93 个全国名单席位和 106 个单一选区席位。此处每个席位都已归属：名单席位来自会议记录，选区席位来自选举办公室的议会构成页面，两者合计 199 席。"全国名单席位"仅指名单层级；"全议院席位"另加选区席位。得票率在各选票内部计算。选举办公室的应用程序按政党名单票和民族名单票合计计算得票率，因此数字不同。一个民族名单达到优惠配额并获得一席，政党名单分配其余 92 席。联合名单的票数和席位（包括由相同组织共同提名的候选人赢得的选区席位）不分配给其各组织。

interval_basis: election-specific rule observation (Act CCIII of 2011, version read on the retrieval date; the minutes apply the same thresholds and method), not legal enactment dates
system_family: mixed: 106 single-member districts and 93 national list seats
allocation_method: national list seats: highest averages over list votes plus surplus votes (§ 16)

national_rules.nationalAllocation: List votes plus surplus votes (töredékszavazat) of qualifying party lists, shared out by highest averages (§ 16).
national_rules.districtAllocation: One round in each of 106 single-member districts; the candidate with the most valid votes is elected (§ 13). District seats per list come from the National Election Office's chamber-composition record; district votes and per-district results are not held.

thresholds.appliesTo: party list

description.en: A party list below 5% of all valid party-list and nationality-list votes wins no list seat (§ 14(1)).
description.zh-CN: 政党名单得票低于政党名单和民族名单有效票总数的 5% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 1 款）。

thresholds.appliesTo: joint party list of two parties

description.en: A joint list of two parties below 10% of the same total wins no list seat (§ 14(2)).
description.zh-CN: 两党联合名单低于同一总数的 10% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 2 款）。

thresholds.appliesTo: joint party list of more than two parties

description.en: A joint list of more than two parties below 15% of the same total wins no list seat (§ 14(2)).
description.zh-CN: 两党以上联合名单低于同一总数的 15% 时，不获得名单席位（第 14 条第 2 款）。

minorityRepresentation.en: A nationality list wins one preferential seat if its votes reach the quota: all national list votes ÷ 93 ÷ 4, whole part (§ 16(d) and (e)). Nationality lists are a separate ballot with their own denominator here.
minorityRepresentation.zh-CN: 民族名单得票达到配额（全部全国名单票 ÷ 93 ÷ 4，取整数部分）时获得一个优惠席位（第 16 条 d、e 项）。此处民族名单是单独的选票，使用各自的分母。

totalSeatsDefinition.en: 199 seats by statute: 106 single-member districts and 93 national list seats (§ 3). Each list shows its national list seats (National Election Commission minutes), its district seats (National Election Office chamber-composition record) and their sum, the whole-chamber seats.
totalSeatsDefinition.zh-CN: 法定 199 席：106 个单一选区席位和 93 个全国名单席位（第 3 条）。各名单显示全国名单席位（国家选举委员会会议记录）、选区席位（国家选举办公室议会构成记录）及两者之和，即全议院席位。

notes.en: Mixed system with 199 seats: 93 national list seats and 106 single-member district seats. Every seat is attributed here: list seats come from the minutes, district seats from the election office's composition page, and the two add up to 199. "National list seats" are the list tier only; "whole-chamber seats" add the district seats. Shares are computed here within each ballot. The election office's application prints shares over party-list and nationality-list votes together, so its figures differ. No nationality list reached the preferential quota, so all 93 list seats went to party lists. A joint list's votes and seats, including the district seats of candidates nominated by the same organisations, are not divided among its organisations.
notes.zh-CN: 混合选制，共 199 席：93 个全国名单席位和 106 个单一选区席位。此处每个席位都已归属：名单席位来自会议记录，选区席位来自选举办公室的议会构成页面，两者合计 199 席。"全国名单席位"仅指名单层级；"全议院席位"另加选区席位。得票率在各选票内部计算。选举办公室的应用程序按政党名单票和民族名单票合计计算得票率，因此数字不同。没有民族名单达到优惠配额，因此 93 个名单席位全部分配给政党名单。联合名单的票数和席位（包括由相同组织共同提名的候选人赢得的选区席位）不分配给其各组织。
